muse-spark-1.2-contributor.reason: Contributor is Meta's discounted data-terms pricing tier of the same Muse Spark 1.2 model, not a different model; writeups describe the full model at ~95% lower cost in exchange for training-data rights.

muse-spark-1.3-contributor.reason: Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor is a pricing and data-terms tier, not a reduced model: vendor material confirms it serves the full Muse Spark 1.3 at roughly 8% of standard cost in exchange for using prompts as training data.
